metadata.description: The agents CLI — one control plane for every AI coding-agent harness. Install the skill so any coding agent surfaces `agents` when you ask how to run multiple agents in parallel, manage multiple accounts, survive a usage limit, resume a session on another machine, or pin the CLI version.

plugins.name: agents-cli
plugins.description: Run and manage many AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi, OpenCode, Droid, …) from one CLI. Bundles the cross-harness `agents-cli` discovery skill plus per-command skills (run, teams, sessions, devices, secrets, browser, workflows).
